title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Fusionz Strawberry Watermelon Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Watermelon Ice by Seriously Fusionz is a divine blend of succulent strawberries and mouth-watering watermelon, all accented by a subtle icy finish. Every puff delivers a taste of summer; the fruity sweetness of strawberries and watermelon with a cool undertone that's refreshingly crisp and endlessly refreshing. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-juice go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks . Experience the apex of vaping pleasure with Doozy Vape Co's Seriously Fusionz collection, featuring a range of six uniquely inventive and exquisitely tasty fruit flavour blends precision engineered to light up your taste buds while satisfying pesky nicotine cravings. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to others in Doozy Vape Co’s Seriously Fusionz collection? From sweet and juicy Fantasia Grape to luscious Tropical Ice and tangy White Peach Lemon, Seriously Fusionz are about as delicious as e-liquids can get. Shortfill e-liquids are ideal for vapers who know what flavours and e-liquid brands they love and who always want a ready supply on hand. They offer a practical way to save money on your favourite e-liquids by reducing the need to frequently buy smaller quantities. Since their higher VG to PG ratio typically makes them suitable for use with high-powered devices, such vape kits often consume e-liquid faster than low-powered vape devices, so having a large bottle of your favourite e-juice ensures you always have your favourite flavour to hand.
